description: This file contains Sass mixins for visually hiding content to improve accessibility while keeping it available for assistive technologies. It defines two mixins: 'visually-hidden' for hiding content visually but accessible, and 'visually-hidden-focusable' for showing content only when focused.

methods.name: visually-hidden
methods.description: A mixin that visually hides content but keeps it accessible to assistive technologies.

methods.name: visually-hidden-focusable
methods.description: A mixin that only displays content when it is focused or contains focused children, useful for skip links.
